content.short: EigenPhi is an in-depth DeFi data analysis platform for searchers, researchers and retail investors.
content.description: EigenPhi, founded in 2021, is a blockchain-native DeFi analytics platform that unlocks insights from growing on-chain data, helping researchers and traders turn raw activity into actionable knowledge. It functions as a deep DeFi data resource, covering MEV, Sandwich Front Runs, Lending, Liquidation, and Flash Loans, and enables users to study complex on-chain activity. The platform provides in-depth data analysis focused on Ethereum and BNB Chain, helping users better understand market dynamics and develop informed strategies for these ecosystems.
